records.jp: あっ……愛央ちゃん、いいところに！<CR>ちょっとお願いがあるんだけど……
records.en_original: Oh, Ao! Glad I ran into you. Could I ask a favor of you?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Ao! Glad I ran into you. Could I ask a favor of you?
records.en: Ah... Ao-chan, perfect timing!<CR>There's a little favor I'd like to ask...

records.jp: うん、いいよ。何をすればいいの
records.en_original: Yeah, of course. What do you need?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, of course. What do you need?
records.en: Yeah, sure. What should I do?

records.jp: えっとね、いくつかやりたいことがあって。<CR>ちょっと手伝ってほしいんだ
records.en_original: Well, there's actually a few things. Do you mind?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, there's actually a few things. Do you mind?
records.en: Well, there are a few things I want to get done.<CR>I'd like a little help.

records.jp: ありがとう！　愛央ちゃんのお蔭で<CR>やりたいことぜーんぶ片付いたよ！
records.en_original: You're the best! Thanks to you, we were able to get through everything!
records.en_auxiliary: You're the best! Thanks to you, we were able to get through everything!
records.en: Thank you! Thanks to you, Ao-chan,<CR>I got every single thing I wanted to do done!

records.jp: どーいたしまして。<CR>それにしても……
records.en_original: No problem! But, come to think of it...
records.en_auxiliary: No problem! But, come to think of it...
records.en: You're welcome.<CR>That said...

records.jp: 建付けが悪くなったドアの修理に、<CR>いらないものの片づけ、そして料理の仕込み……
records.en_original: We fixed a door with a bad hinge, reorganized a lot of clutter, and even prepared some food...
records.en_auxiliary: We fixed a door with a bad hinge, reorganized a lot of clutter, and even prepared some food...
records.en: Repairing a door that wasn't fitting right,<CR>putting away things we didn't need, and preparing food...

records.jp: 全部ひとりでやろうと思ってたの？
records.en_original: Were you really planning on doing this all yourself?
records.en_auxiliary: Were you really planning on doing this all yourself?
records.en: Were you planning to do all of that by yourself?

records.jp: ううん、そんなことないよ
records.en_original: Well, no. Not really.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, no. Not really.
records.en: No, not at all.

records.jp: 助けて～ってお願いしたら、愛央ちゃんは<CR>きっと手を貸してくれるだろうなって思ってたんだ
records.en_original: I was pretty sure you would lend me a hand if I asked you nicely.
records.en_auxiliary: I was pretty sure you would lend me a hand if I asked you nicely.
records.en: I just thought that if I asked for help,<CR>Ao-chan would definitely lend me a hand.

records.jp: 普段からみんなのために頑張ってる姿、見てたし……。<CR>愛央ちゃんのこと、信じてるから！
records.en_original: I know how hard you're always working for everyone. There's a reason you're our leader. I believe in you!
records.en_auxiliary: I know how hard you're always working for everyone. There's a reason you're our leader. I believe in you!
records.en: I've seen how hard you work for everyone all the time...<CR>Because I believe in you, Ao-chan!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: （……なんか、恥ずかしいな。<CR>でも、陽桜莉さんにそう言ってもらえるのは、嬉しい）
records.en_original: (It's nice to hear that she feels that way. ...Though it is a little embarrassing.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's nice to hear that she feels that way. ...Though it is a little embarrassing.)
records.en: (...This is kind of embarrassing.<CR>But it makes me happy to have Hiori-san say that.)

records.jp: （こんなふうに信じてもらえたら、<CR>もっともっと、陽桜莉さんのために……）
records.en_original: (It makes me want to do more for her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It makes me want to do more for her.)
records.en: (If she believes in me like this,<CR>then for Hiori-san's sake, I want to do even more...)

records.en_original: Oh...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...
records.en: Ah...

records.jp: ん？　どうしたの？
records.en_original: Hm? Is something wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? Is something wrong?
records.en: Hm? What's wrong?

records.jp: あのさ。陽桜莉さん、前に自分のこと、<CR>偉い人間じゃないって言ってたけど……
records.en_original: Do you remember when you told me that you didn't think you were a good person?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you remember when you told me that you didn't think you were a good person?
records.en: Hey. Before, you said<CR>you weren't such an admirable person, Hiori-san, but...

records.jp: 私はやっぱり、陽桜莉さんの真っ直ぐなとこ、<CR>眩しくて素敵だと思うよ
records.en_original: I really think you are. You're genuine, and you practically radiate kindness.
records.en_auxiliary: I really think you are. You're genuine, and you practically radiate kindness.
records.en: I still think your straightforward side,<CR>Hiori-san, is dazzling and wonderful.

records.jp: だって、陽桜莉さんに信じてもらえると、<CR>それだけで力が湧いてくるもん
records.en_original: Just hearing that you believe in me gives me a ton of confidence.
records.en_auxiliary: Just hearing that you believe in me gives me a ton of confidence.
records.en: Because when you believe in me,<CR>that alone gives me strength, Hiori-san.

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: ていうか、陽桜莉さんは物事の表の側しか<CR>見えてないって言ってたけど……
records.en_original: You said you only take things at surface value, but...
records.en_auxiliary: You said you only take things at surface value, but...
records.en: I mean, you said you can only see<CR>the outward side of things, Hiori-san, but...

records.jp: 表の自分って、その人が見せたい自分だと思うんだ
records.en_original: I think the things people show on the surface is how they'd like to be viewed by others.
records.en_auxiliary: I think the things people show on the surface is how they'd like to be viewed by others.
records.en: I think a person's outward self is the self they want others to see.

records.jp: それを信じて、ちゃんと見てくれる人がいる。<CR>だから頑張れるっていう人は、きっとたくさんいるはず
records.en_original: I think there are a lot of people who appreciate people like you who view them as they want to be viewed.
records.en_auxiliary: I think there are a lot of people who appreciate people like you who view them as they want to be viewed.
records.en: And there are surely lots of people who can keep going<CR>because someone believes that and truly sees them.

records.jp: そう……なの、かなぁ……
records.en_original: Do you...really think so?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you...really think so?
records.en: Do... do you really think so...?

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃん……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: ...Ao-chan...

records.jp: ……自分を信じて
records.en_original: Believe in yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: Believe in yourself.
records.en: ...Believe in yourself.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんと関わった人たちは、多分だけど、<CR>陽桜莉さんのそういう部分に救われたんだと思う
records.en_original: I know that plenty of people have been saved by that part of you.
records.en_auxiliary: I know that plenty of people have been saved by that part of you.
records.en: The people who have been involved with you, Hiori-san, probably—<CR>at least I think so—have been saved by that side of you.

records.jp: 私は、めっちゃ救われてるよ。<CR>つい、からかっちゃったりするけど
records.en_original: I may tease you, but I know that I have too.
records.en_auxiliary: I may tease you, but I know that I have too.
records.en: I've been saved by it a whole lot.<CR>Even if I can't help teasing you sometimes.

records.jp: うん、信じる。<CR>私を信じてくれる、愛央ちゃんを信じる
records.en_original: Okay. I believe you. You believe in me, so I'll believe in you too.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. I believe you. You believe in me, so I'll believe in you too.
records.en: Yeah, I'll believe.<CR>I'll believe in Ao-chan, who believes in me.

records.jp: ……そっか
records.en_original: ...Good.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Good.
records.en: ...I see.

records.jp: えへへ……なんか、元気出てきちゃった！<CR>よーし……！　これからも頑張るぞー！
records.en_original: Hehe. I feel a lot better now! All right, I'm gonna keep doing what I do!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. I feel a lot better now! All right, I'm gonna keep doing what I do!
records.en: Ehehe... Somehow, I feel energized again!<CR>All right...! I'll keep doing my best from here on too!

records.jp: おー！　……って、なにを頑張るの？
records.en_original: Good! So... What are you planning to do?
records.en_auxiliary: Good! So... What are you planning to do?
records.en: Ooh! ...Wait, what are you going to do your best at?

records.jp: んーっとね、いろいろ！
records.en_original: Hmm... Lots of stuff!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Lots of stuff!
records.en: Umm, lots of things!

records.jp: （そう言って陽桜莉さんが笑顔を浮かべるのは、<CR>私に笑ってほしいからなのかもしれない）
records.en_original: (I think Hiori smiles because she wants others to smile with her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I think Hiori smiles because she wants others to smile with her.)
records.en: (The reason Hiori-san smiles when she says that<CR>might be because she wants me to smile.)

records.jp: （……そんな陽桜莉さんの力に、私はなりたい）
records.en_original: (I want to be able to support her in that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I want to be able to support her in that.)
records.en: (...I want to become Hiori-san's strength.)

records.jp: <CLGR>陽桜莉<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Hiori's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Hiori's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked<CR>in <CLGR>Hiori's<CLNR> Talents.
